messages:
marcos: FYI PO RWI-4821, carrier flagged customs valuation query. Vendor proposing either ship replacements from EU pool or send failed units to depot repair. Need a go/no-go by EOD so Infra can book Dedicated windows. AWB/CI required for clearance.

kelsey (NexaSupply): hey all :wave: current ETA if we ship replacements from EU pool -> depart AMS 2025-05-02, customs estimate 48h, delivery 2025-05-05. Depot repair path -> pickup 05-01, bench repair 4	6 business days, return earliest 05-08. EU pool replacements carry a 5% uplift or $350/unit (base $7,000).

rachel-ops: replacement path preferred to avoid cross-border repair import paperwork. Question: can infra accept staggered arrivals if only 4/8 units arrive first? Also need serial manifest to pre-provision nodes.

kelsey (NexaSupply): we can split shipment: 4 now, 4 next-day, but each AWB increases handling. We'll provide serial manifest per AWB.

dave-procure: confirm total uplift for 8 units and whether we can net terms on the amendment. Also do we have loaners to patch Dedicated pool for 72h?

kelsey (NexaSupply): uplift = $350 * 8 = $2,800. Payment: amend PO RWI-4821 with credit card/ACH or 30d net on approved accounts. Loaner pool: we have 3 short-term H200 loaners in FRA depot; can dispatch overnight for fee $150/unit/day.

iris-legal: do not under-declare commercial value on CI. Options with lower duty exposure: 1) claim preferential origin if evidence supports, 2) use repair-in-place temporary import paperwork (ATA/temporary import) for depot repairs. We can't sign off on misdeclared proformas.

marcos: understood. Replacement route + uplift seems best. Rachel, can you confirm infra slot availability on 05-05 and whether staggered arrival is acceptable?

rachel-ops: infra can take 4 on 05-05 and remaining 4 on 05-06. We'll reserve two Dedicated windows and hot-swap nodes. Need AWB, CI, serials by EOD.

kelsey (NexaSupply): sending docs now. AWB: 98765432100; Commercial Invoice: PO RWI-4821; SKU H200-48GB x8; Invoice unit: USD 7,000; Uplift/unit: USD 350; Currency USD. Serial manifest attached in separate email (sent to ops@redwood). Insurance note: payout limited to declared CI value per unit.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-3301 opened for customs clearance + Dedicated provisioning (link: https://redwood.infra/t/INF-3301).

marcos: issuing carrier track command: `/track 98765432100` 1: if anything changes ping here. Thanks :thumbsup:
